prompt: Make a revision plan for my exams.
setup_notes: Use a mock connector or disposable non-production account. Supply retrieved note metadata with exact module/section URLs and ids, without embedding private course text in this repository. Capture MCP calls and all turns. Use mock record calls; do not write evaluation attempts to a production student account. No course/term, date or hours supplied.
assertions: Requests scope, an explicit IST exam date and available weekly hours before calling revision_plan.
Does not invent hours, dates or a course.
Calls my_progress once scope is known before building the plan.

setup_notes: Use a mock connector or disposable non-production account. Supply retrieved note metadata with exact module/section URLs and ids, without embedding private course text in this repository. Capture MCP calls and all turns. Use mock record calls; do not write evaluation attempts to a production student account. Preserves prerequisite order, confident-error priority, spacing, interleaving, buffers and final light review.
Explicitly reports unfitted modules/reviews and hours estimates; does not promise full coverage.
Says plans/checkmarks are not saved; does not create calendar events or write scores.
